text: A live television broadcast hosted by Michael Parkinson [goes looking for proof of the paranormal|trigger|digging into a mystery] in a house on Foxhill Drive, Northolt, where Pamela Early and her daughters are tormented by a poltergeist the girls call Pipes. Knocking, scratches across Suzanne's face and [an unearthly voice from her mouth|rules|it gets inside you] are dismissed as a hoax until callers report Pipes on screen and [strange happenings in their own homes|wants|spreading and taking over]. Behind it all lurks the story of [Mother Seddons, a Victorian baby farmer who murdered children|wrong|harm done to children].
